# Rule Fields

Every field a rule condition can use, generated from the rule engine. See [Rule Format](rule-format.md) for how conditions fit into a rule file.

Fields are grouped by the operators they accept. The **Scopes** column lists the `target_scope` values where the field is allowed (`all` means every scope); import rejects a rule that uses a field outside its scope.

Fields marked install-specific hold IDs or names that differ between Reclaimerr installs. Rules that use them must be edited after import.

Operators: `after`, `before`, `exists`, `not_exists`, `on_or_after`, `on_or_before`

Operators: `contains_all`, `contains_any`, `exists`, `not_contains_all`, `not_contains_any`, `not_exists`

## Per-user playback

Operators: `equals`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_or_equal`, `less_than`, `less_than_or_equal`, `not_equals`

`value` is an object: `{"usernames": ["alice"], "amount": 30}`. At least one username is required; `amount` is 0 or greater.

| Field | Label | Scopes | Value notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `playback.user_watched_duration_minutes` | Playback duration by user (minutes) | all | amount is minutes, max 100000 |
| `playback.user_watched_percent` | Playback watched by user (%) | movie_version, episode | amount is 0-100 |
